title: Let placement probes run to their own budget
goal: A placement run longer than 15 s but within its timeoutMs returns its result instead of a closed connection
acceptance: A committed test fails first: a placement run whose inference takes longer than 15 s and less than its timeoutMs returns its result
/api/placement/run sets its socket timeout from the probe budget, as the chat routes do
privacy: Neutral fixtures and invented data only; no secrets, tokens or personal data in Git.
escalation: A material scope or effort increase goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-24: failing test and a timeout fix like the chat route. Not a measurement.
